## What’s new
- Recommendations you approve or exclude on your iPhone, and time logs you change there, now show up on your Mac within seconds, even with Beacon's window left open. Before, the Mac only caught up when you switched back to it or edited something.

## What’s new
- Merging proposals in the Report now asks how to count the time between them when there's a gap: only the worked time, or the whole span from the first start to the last end. - AI prompt lead-in: the daily review starts work that begins with a Codex or T3 Code conversation 5 minutes earlier, for writing the first prompt. It never overlaps earlier work. Turn it off or change the minutes in Settings → General → Billing defaults.

## What’s new
- Month view: each day shows a color bar of the clients you worked on (hover a color to see the client and time), days tint deeper with billable hours, and a Week column totals each week’s billable time and revenue. - The Dashboard tab is called Dashboard for everyone. Owners open on My Dashboard; finance admins open on Cash Flow and can also see the Owner Dashboard (the monthly goal and what’s ready to invoice).

## What’s new
- A day that hasn’t been analyzed shows each Mac’s evidence: sent, still updating, capture problems, or not sent yet. Hover a not-analyzed day in Day’s week strip to see which Mac it’s waiting on. - “Ask to send”: ask another Mac to capture and send a day from this Mac or your iPhone. An awake, signed-in Capture-only Mac sends it right away.

## What’s new
- On a Capture-only Mac, Day has “Send this Mac’s evidence”: it captures the day and sends it to your Reviewer Mac right away, and shows when it was last sent. The Reviewer still analyzes a day only once every Mac’s evidence is in. - Signing back in sends anything that piled up while signed out immediately. - Beacon no longer signs you out when the server has a hiccup while restoring your session (for example right after an update). Only a session the server rejects is forgotten.

## What’s new
- Back and Forward: your mouse’s back/forward buttons, a two-finger swipe, or ⌘[ / ⌘] return to the screen you were just on (Go menu). In the Time calendar, ← / → still step days. - Day review shows every other day with proposals waiting, a Next day button once a day is done, Exclude for several proposals at once, and a Reviewed list where an exclusion can be restored. - Proposals show their full description, and the review header shows pending billable time and which Mac reviewed the day. - The proposal editor has a Billable switch and lists only the projects you’re assigned to that day. - Calendars mark days with proposals to review (blue dot) and past days not analyzed yet (amber ring): a week strip on Day, Week, Month, and the date picker.

## What’s new
- Signing in with a typed password now offers to save the login in Passwords or 1Password, with one-click copy for the website, email and password, so “Fill from Passwords” works next time. - Logins saved for the Beacon web portal (beacon.vervetechgroup.com) now fill in the app.

## What’s new
- A Capture-only Mac resends its evidence from October 12 on, one time, so the Reviewer Mac gets the T3 Code threads it missed. Use Analyze again on those days to include them.

## What’s new
- Rules are shared between your Macs. Add, edit, or delete a rule on one Mac and the other follows. - Rules are easier to manage. Each rule reads as a sentence and shows how often it matched recently, and rules that haven't matched in 90 days are marked Unused. Click a rule to edit it in a side panel, with a live preview of what it catches and a warning when another client's rule overlaps. Saves and deletions can be undone. - Companies → All rules lists every rule, and ⌘K finds rules too. Rules no longer appear in Settings. - New Code project rules send a T3 Code or Codex project to a client. Choose from a list of your projects. - Beacon reads T3 Code threads again. A T3 Code update in mid-October had hidden them from daily reviews.

## What’s new
- Notes on invoices, payables, and companies: each note shows who added it and when, newest first. Notes are searchable, and you can choose who gets an email about a new note. - Names of other records are now links. Clients, people, projects, invoices, and payables mentioned on a record open that record, including invoice line items, related payables, a payable’s “What for,” and matches in Banking. - A brief network interruption no longer signs Beacon out.
